calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, s.format, s.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900)
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM l GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_receipt_line,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM l GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT store_id)>1 OR count(DISTINCT sale_date)>1 OR count(DISTINCT format)>1)) AS receipts_split,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM l GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1)) AS receipts_mixed_staff,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT channel_id) FROM l) AS channel_ids,
 (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT coalesce(channel_id::VARCHAR,'null'),',') FROM l) AS ch_list,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02) AS vat_mismatch,
 (SELECT min(etl_loaded_at)||' / '||max(etl_loaded_at) FROM l) AS etl_range,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at::DATE) FROM l) AS etl_days,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE member_key IS NULL) AS nonmember_lines

calls.statement:
WITH f AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, s.store_id, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc, sum(f.net_amount) net
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, receipts, net_sales_before_returns nb FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900)
SELECT count(*) AS combos, sum((f.rc IS NULL)::INT) AS only_rpt, sum((r.receipts IS NULL)::INT) AS only_fact,
 sum((f.rc<>r.receipts)::INT) AS rc_diff, sum((abs(f.net-r.nb)>0.01)::INT) AS net_diff, sum(f.rc) fact_rc, sum(r.receipts) rpt_rc, sum(f.net) fact_net, sum(r.nb) rpt_net
FROM f FULL JOIN r ON f.sale_date=r.business_date AND f.store_id=r.store_id

calls.statement:
SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, round(sum(f.net_amount)/count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id),2) avg_basket
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN (fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key AND s.store_id<900) ON f.sale_date=d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH receipts AS (
 SELECT s.format, f.receipt_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS receipt_net, sum(f.gross_amount) AS receipt_gross, bool_or(f.staff_purchase_flag) AS staff
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
   AND s.store_id < 900 AND f.channel_id = 1
 GROUP BY s.format, f.receipt_id)
SELECT format AS store_format, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period,
 round(avg(receipt_net) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff), 2) AS avg_basket_value_eur_ex_vat,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff) AS n_receipts,
 round(avg(receipt_net), 2) AS incl_staff_ex_vat,
 round(avg(receipt_gross) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff), 2) AS excl_staff_incl_vat
FROM receipts GROUP BY format ORDER BY CASE format WHEN 'Small' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
